fields.label: Location
fields.note: URL slug form (e.g. location=united-states-USA); the Refine by panel also has a location typeahead.

fields.label: Team
fields.note: URL uses team codes (SFTWR, HRDWR, MLAI, CORPSV, ...); UI control is 'Enter teams' typeahead.

fields.label: Employment type
fields.note: Record-derived; no employment-type control in the search UI, filtered locally.

fields.label: Workplace
fields.note: Rendered as the 'Home office' checkbox (input#filter-location-home-office); its URL/API parameter is not exposed, filtered locally.

notes: jobs.apple.com search is a React app. Portal-emitted links carry ?search=, ?team= (team code) and ?location= (country slug). The client request is POST https://jobs.apple.com/api/v1/search with an X-Apple-CSRF-Token from /api/v1/CSRFToken and body {query, filters, page, locale, sort}; a direct POST with {"query":"AppDynamics","filters":{},"page":1,"locale":"en-us","sort":"newest"} returned HTTP 200 and a filtered totalRecords, so keyword search is machine-usable through the body field 'query'. The UI also exposes keyword, location and teams typeaheads plus a language typeahead; the API 'filters' object schema was not observed with a populated filter, so non-keyword facets are applied locally.
